summary: Prevent disjoint peer work-start starvation and bound controller store observation (v0.20.147)

delivery.outcome: Eliminate work-start admission starvation under continuous disjoint peer writes (#602), restore bounded streaming controller store observation above 4 MiB across work-start/recovery/restoration plus authenticated archive-preserving controller store compaction (#599), and prepare release 0.20.147.
nonGoals: No runtime dependencies or implicit controller mutations from read-only observers
No edits to sibling ticket worktrees or foreign lease files

architecture.decision: Scope work_start_check end-of-observation retry failures so disjoint uncommitted mutations inside already-registered, non-quarantined peer ticket worktrees with unchanged HEAD/branch/intent/activity update coherently; add a stdlib streaming RFC 8259 controller projection parser in work_start_check shared by ticket_recovery and ticket_restoration; and ship managed controller_store_compaction.py with CAS, flock, and content-addressed archival.
architecture.rollback: Independent reviewed revert; preserve immutable releases and external controller state.

validation.evidence: Disjoint peer dirty progression admits coherently while selected/primary/overlapping/intent/status/ref mutations fail closed.

Controller stores exceeding 4 MiB stream cleanly in O(1) lease memory across work-start, recovery, restoration, and snapshot materialization while malformed/duplicate/racing/oversize stores fail closed.

controller_store_compaction.py compacts >4 MiB historical stores under flock + CAS, writes content-addressed archives, and preserves fencing tokens, active/expired/merged leases, and idempotency receipts.
All regression suites, version parity checks, wellman wheel checks, and repository governance checks pass for 0.20.147.
